doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Bill Evans's Symbiosis
summary: Laws recalls working with Claus Ogerman but not the Bill Evans date, which he did not know about.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: Then the next one, Bill Evans, Symbiosis, with Claus Ogerman orchestra. Again, you’re a section player.
Bill Evans and Claus Ogerman orchestra.
I remember recording with Claus Ogerman, but I don’t recall that. I do remember him writing these wonderful arrangements, but I just don’t recall.
Bill’s trio then was with Eddie Gomez and Marty Morrell.
That’s good to know. I didn’t know I played with Bill Evans.
Maybe you did. Maybe you played on – like you said, “I don’t remember recording with Mingus,” but you have – maybe not, but it was his date.
That’s good to know. I would have listed them in my . . .
